about.title: About me
about.summary: I'm a front-end developer and illustrator with a graphic design background. I build accessible, characterful web experiences and create visual work shaped by clarity, curiosity, and careful detail.
intro: I'm Nelly, a multidisciplinary digital creative based in Madrid. I build accessible front-end experiences and create illustration for digital products, often finding ways for the two disciplines to meet.

My career began in graphic design, creating work for major international brands. That background taught me to think carefully about composition, communication and the purpose behind every visual decision. I later moved into illustration, working across product artwork, icons, pixel art and graphic animation.

Learning front-end development grew naturally from wanting to bring my own ideas to life. Instead of stopping at how something should look, I wanted to understand how it worked and build the finished experience myself. I now work primarily with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with a particular interest in creative projects that combine useful interactions with a strong visual identity.

My experience in technical support and software testing has shaped the way I approach that work. I think about how people will actually use what I build, what might go wrong and how the experience can be made clearer. Accessibility, responsive design, testing and debugging are part of the process from the beginning.

sections.title: How I work
paragraphs: I believe useful products can still have personality. Whether I am building an interactive tool or drawing a peculiar character, I care about the details and test my work thoroughly. I want the finished result to feel considered, dependable and unmistakably made by a person.

sections.title: A little more about me
paragraphs: I'm Mexican, based in Madrid, and fluent in Spanish, English and French. I hold a master's degree in Administration and I am an ISTQB® Certified Tester.
I'm particularly interested in front-end development, creative coding, product illustration and projects where code and illustration belong in the same world.

notes: Graphic designer background with international brand experience.
Illustration across product, web, icons, pixel art, and motion.
Mexican, multilingual, and ISTQB® Certified Tester.

cv.headline: Curriculum
cv.intro: Technical support lead, front-end developer and illustrator with experience in software testing, documentation, partner training, graphic design and art direction.
profile: I am a collaborative, detail-oriented digital creative with a strong technical support and testing background, now focused on front-end development and visually considered web experiences. I bring together clear communication, careful documentation, problem-solving and a practical understanding of how people actually use digital products.

I work well across teams because I am used to translating between customers, partners, developers and internal stakeholders. I can spot patterns in recurring issues, explain complex problems clearly, document useful solutions and help others feel supported while the work moves forward.

My design and illustration background gives me a strong eye for layout, tone and visual detail, while my testing experience keeps me grounded in quality, accessibility and reliability. I enjoy projects where thoughtful code, useful interaction and a strong visual identity all need to work together.

experience.role: Second Line Support / Technical Support Lead
details: Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify and document bugs, errors, workarounds and product limitations.
Prepare and deliver partner training in person and remotely, while continuing to create clear help documentation.
Use agile workflows and tools including JIRA and Cucumber, with hands-on experience creating bug reports.
Provided first line support through Zendesk, chat and phone in Spanish and English.
Created documentation for direct customers, partners and new hires.
Onboarded, trained and mentored new resources, and documented workarounds to reduce repeated issue escalation.
Worked as part of a team responsible for international clients, collaborating closely with illustration and web design teams.
Managed a small team of designers and publicists.
Served as lead designer for main international accounts and oversaw work submitted for national clients.
